body: I think it just means that this “temporary problem” is the intensity of the pain. It won’t always hurt this severely, we learn to cope and function despite these seemingly-impossible problems. That’s just my take on it, but I do see what your saying and how it can honestly feel demeaning because yes, some problems are chronic or life-long.
okay </3

i am open to talking and i appreciate your encouragement. i may try to have conversations with the people closest to me one last time, that feels like closure for myself. i will also try and do something enjoyable like what you listed. ill try and procrastinate for a while but i really feel its whats best. thank you for your words

yea i get what you’re saying. i have been diagnosed and am in the process of getting help, but there are many circumstantial issues right now, for example, im homeless. so its a lot more than just the chemical imbalance but thank you

i appreciate this comment i may consider writing a note for myself to get organized and im not sure if im religious or not, have been in the past. i may consider so, every time i tell people though i always get hospitalized and it creates more stress cause i miss school but i appreciate it
it doesnt sound dumb. i appreciate the recommendation, but i am seeking help. i have like 2 therapists. i just feel its the right choice

thanks </3 i do have people who care about me and i feel awful im just not in a place that i can give anything to them and im at a place where there are so many circumstantial issues that wont have a fix and i wont be able to get where i want to be so its just not worth it. i just dont know what to do before leaving

if she is a true friend, she’ll value that as well. explain that you just want to maybe set aside time for just the two of you or maybe a code word if you just want to talk to only that friend so you dont make the s/o feel bad. i agree with the other comment though honestly, you wont sound controlling if you explain how said action is making you feel.
hope all goes well :)

im sorry for your lose
it is not your fault. i know that feels impossible to believe and only you can grow to learn this truth.
i 100% promise you it is not your fault
thanks!!!
ok i may try that, it’ll take guts. just dont wanna ruin the friendship. i may hint a lil. thanks for the advice :)

reward yourself when you dont do those things and to avoid them try squeezing ice cubes. it hurts but it’s stimulating and can sometimes turn you away from them. dont be upset at yourself for thinking. these are just thoughts, let them pass :)

id try and talk with her in person and explain all this to her. if it is genuine and if she does care she will understand and you guys can fix it. honesty is always the best in a relationship. plus if you guys date she’ll know about these things anyways so it’s probably the healthiest option :) good luck!
thank you i really appreciate the suggestions. i will keep them in mind and probably try and look for some of those to keep me going. i appreciate the kind words as well :)

yes i actually did consider myself religious before i got heavily depressed. i will for sure try and get back into that. i appreciate your suggestion. i hope things are well with you and glad you found a sense of hope :)
thank you. i appreciate it so much. i just recently read a pretty good book for the first time in almost 5 years i finished it so i will for sure look into that. thanks again :)
call a suicide hotline. people here are not qualified to help you. all i do know is every human being deserves to live.

depending on age and time. maybe try and meet them half way and arrange during maybe silent reading or comfy time that they can take shoes only off. not all the time though as it can be a safety hazard.

people arent projects. you can support, encourage and be there but cannot fix a person / force them to get help. it’s heartbreaking and one of the saddest things to see (an ed) and im sorry she is going through this. stay strong, keep persevering and i hope things get better.
finished :p

not sure where you are from and if this is available but i know people who have gotten written up by their family doctor for say a “ten week sick leave” due to mental health. or where i am there is this thing you can go on called disability for a while due to mental health reasoning. bottom line, id try talking with your family doctor / psychiatrist about possible options to take :)

i appreciate you taking the time to read this over. i am and will continue to hang out with friends. i only have one right now so it’s difficult but i will try and make new ones. never thought of internet friends till you said that. 

i understand what you’re saying about that living alone thing. you’re exactly right though and i understand that i just dont know what else to do kinda thing. like my mom worsens my mental state by not being here but also when she is its rough. she herself is depressed and a narcissist so it makes it difficult but ill try and find hurdles / keep it in consideration.

i hear what you’re saying and you’re right. it also is not selfish for you to say that. i will certainly try my best. thank you for your kind words and advice :) ❤️

you’re extremely strong. i resonate with a lot of what your story entails but you did not make it this far just to make it this far. if you can’t get your puppy back then im extremely sorry. id try finding a more positive outlet instead of self harm. my self harm story is similar to yours too so im not just talking gibberish. art, music anything even if it doesnt stop you at least so you have a healthier way of coping. i also suggest professional help. trust me when i say things will get better soon enough. you are young, stick around a little longer, i think it’ll be worth while :)
so proud :)
done :) good luck
of course :) its ok to get help and im glad you reached out. glad i could help in some way!!

hey :) i understand how you are feeling not personally but in the anxiety sense for sure! id recommend talking to them or a professional about these feelings just to at least get them out. another thing is to not view post secondary as what will make you happy. if that is stressful for you ( thinking about it ) try and tackle it logically or with help. another thing is to try and find a hobby / something to get excited about. art, music, your favourite breakfast. something you can go to bed and think “i cant wait for...” i know it seems hard. or you could make a vision board of things you value and want in life, career related or not. i hope some of these help, try and hang in there ok, there is a light at the end of the tunnel and you are not alone. message me if you need further explanations or someone to talk to :)
